# RevenueCat

Skills that teach agents to work with RevenueCat. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [RevenueCat/rc-claude-code-plugin](https://github.com/RevenueCat/rc-claude-code-plugin), at commit `ccfc038`.

Set up RevenueCat, integrate it, and access data.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **RevenueCat**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **RevenueCat**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install revenuecat@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

24 skills: `create-revenuecat-project`, `integrate-revenuecat`, `revenuecat`, `revenuecat-app-valuation`, `revenuecat-audiences`, `revenuecat-billing`, `revenuecat-charts`, `revenuecat-cli`, `revenuecat-customer-center`, `revenuecat-dashboard-links`, `revenuecat-entitlements-gate`, `revenuecat-experiment-analysis`, `revenuecat-experiments`, `revenuecat-forecasting`, `revenuecat-identify-user`, `revenuecat-migrate`, `revenuecat-paywall`, `revenuecat-paywall-design`, `revenuecat-purchase-flow`, `revenuecat-sdk-compatibility`, `revenuecat-status`, `revenuecat-store-state`, `revenuecat-testing-setup`, `revenuecat-troubleshoot`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `RC_API_KEY`, `REVENUECAT_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.
